summary: TFI International Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a routine current report) containing a press release dated October 16, 2026, announcing a timing adjustment to its third-quarter 2026 earnings webcast. Results remain scheduled for release Thursday, October 29, 2026, after market close, with the webcast moved to Friday, October 30, 2026, at 8:30 AM Eastern Time. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory terms are disclosed. This is a scheduling/logistics notice only; no deal or risk-arb angle applies.
